04 / MASTER’S THESIS

Master’s thesis: Data Spaces.

Universidade do Minho · 2026

MASTER’S DISSERTATION

Proposal of an Approach for Inter-Organizational Data Architecture: Data Spaces

Rui Pedro Fernandes Coelho

105 pagesFull dissertation · PDF

How can organisations share data and retain control?

My research proposes a federated architecture for data sharing across organisational boundaries. It brings together data sovereignty, discovery, contracts and reviewable access decisions.

I developed a domain model, conceptual and technological architectures, and a controlled proof of concept using versioned governance artifacts and Databricks analytical views.

3fictional organisations
2source data products
1derived analytics product

Research scope: a governed-sharing demonstrator. Production-scale performance and automated policy enforcement are future work.

Method Design Science Research

FROM SPORT TO ENGINEERING

What competitive sport taught me.

I was a national champion in K1 kayaking. High-performance sport taught me discipline, consistency and how to stay focused under pressure, habits I bring to my work in engineering.

Today, endurance sports and photography keep that curiosity alive. Sometimes that means building a training analytics tool. Sometimes it means putting the screen away and taking a camera outside.
